description: A 3-reel emoji slot machine with weighted reels, adjustable bets, real payout odds, and 100 starting credits.

faqs.a: Each symbol has a real weight — 7️⃣ is rarest, 🍒 most common — so payouts reflect true odds.
Three of a kind pays 2×–50× your bet; any two matching symbols returns your bet.
You start with 100 credits and can bet 1, 5, 10, or 25 per spin.
faqs.q: How many credits do I start with?

faqs.a: Press Reset credits to go back to 100 anytime.
faqs.q: What if I run out of credits?

howto: Press SPIN and watch the reels.
Three of a kind pays up to 50×!
Two of a kind returns your bet.
title: Slot Machine Game
